subject: Estimate & implementation timeline for Arcadia Health
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Chris Jones <chris.jones@arcadiahealth.com>, Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Estimate & implementation timeline for Arcadia Health

Hi Chris / Lydia —

Great to meet earlier today. Per our discovery, I’ve attached the estimate and a short implementation timeline that reflects the initial scope we discussed (pilot: anonymized inference, 3 models, integration via API). Key highlights: 

- Monthly committed capacity: 200M tokens
- Target latency SLO: <150ms p95 on sample workload
- Estimated monthly cost (hosted + premium support): $28k — see PDF for line items and optional Dedicated pricing

Attachments: Arcadia_Estimate_Redwood_20270510.pdf; Redwood_Implementation_Timeline.xlsx; SOW-draft-Arcadia.docx

Next steps I proposed on the call were: 1) your internal review of the estimate, 2) a 30-minute pricing walk-through where I can answer sizing/quant questions and explain fallback/routing options, and 3) optional procurement intro if you want our procurement lead involved.

Do either Wed or Thu this week work for a quick walk-through? If not, send over a couple of windows and I’ll book.

Thanks — happy to adjust scope if priority or timeline changed since the call.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(h) +1 415 555 0142 | schedule: https://cal.redwood.com/hannah/15m

From: Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Chris Jones <chris.jones@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Estimate & implementation timeline for Arcadia Health

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for sending this over. I see the attachments and will share them with our platform team for a technical sanity check. A couple quick clarifications for the finance team:

- Does the estimate assume hosted API use only, or does it include an optional Dedicated baseline? The PDF price line is a bit dense, so a simple callout would help.
- Is there an expected start-of-billing date if we sign in June?

I’m out of office Thursday but should have feedback by Monday. If you have 15 minutes next week to walk through the pricing lines, I’ll block time.

Best,
Lydia
Head of Platform Engineering
Arcadia Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Chris Jones <chris.jones@arcadiahealth.com>, Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check: estimate + walkthrough?

Hi Lydia / Chris —

Following up on the estimate I shared on Monday. Wanted to confirm you received the PDF and timeline — also happy to do a quick 20-minute walk-through to call out differences between Hosted vs Dedicated pricing and typical migration steps.

If it helps, I can do: Mon 5/17 10:00–11:30 PT or Tue 5/18 14:00–16:00 PT. Alternatively, send a time that works for your team and I’ll accommodate.

Dev (cc) — looping you in in case procurement or contract questions start to surface.

Thanks — no pressure if the timeline shifted, just trying to make scheduling easier.

Best,
Hannah
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Chris Jones <chris.jones@arcadiahealth.com>, Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Checking priority/timing for Arcadia estimate

Hi Chris / Lydia —

Just nudging this back to the top of your inbox. If your timeline has shifted, no problem — we can either pause next steps or compress to a short exec-level overview for stakeholders. Two quick options:

1) 20-minute technical + pricing walkthrough (I’ll bring Marissa for procurement/contract Qs)
2) Pause active outreach until you confirm internal priority (I’ll follow up in two weeks)

If you prefer a different cadence, tell me what works and I’ll make it happen.

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Internal note: Marissa, looping you in for the procurement angle only if they confirm a June signing window. Dev, FYI on potential need for a Dedicated pricing carve-out.
From: Chris Jones <chris.jones@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checking priority/timing for Arcadia estimate

Hi Hannah —

Apologies for the slow reply — we hit a backlog of security reviews this week. Thanks for the follow-ups and for the clear materials. We have two quick asks before scheduling a walkthrough: 

1) Confirm whether the estimate assumes a hosted-only deployment by default (Lydia had the same question). If hosted is assumed, can you add a 1-paragraph line item for the Dedicated baseline so finance can compare?
2) Do you have a brief list of required audit artifacts (SOC 2 / retention / VPC options) we can share with security?

If you can send those two items, we can commit to a 30-minute call next Wednesday (5/19) 11:00–11:30 PT. Does that work for you?

Thanks,
Chris
Director of Product
Arcadia Health
